limitations: Synthetic fixed-seed workloads and malformed rates; no captured production distribution.
Per-thread user-mode counters exclude kernel and hypervisor; fixture construction and warmup excluded; timed allocation/refill and small clock/control overhead included.
No application latency/throughput, socket backpressure, event enqueue, receive dispatch, shedding or ID-allocation measurements.
Outbound phase omits ReliableUnordered; merge operation is a 32-packet batch; do not aggregate unlike phase rates.
One laptop session; no significance test; power/clock/thermal state not continuously sampled; other user processes were not stopped.
Assembly probes isolate decoder, not every production call site; cold-helper effects not individually isolated.
Only two balanced blocks (four independent processes per variant); smaller than original series.
decision: Reject the match-restoration candidate: no local decoder timing improvement and parse timing worsened in both blocks. Retain original table/cold-extraction production code; correct unsupported rationale and comments.
final_harness_note: All measurements used the frozen benchmark files from this revision. A later edit only corrects the outbound delivery-method comment.
